description: Runnable parameter recipes selected for the manuscript. No measured outputs or private random seeds are included. Source commits identify configuration extraction, not necessarily the historical binary used to obtain a published row.

normalization.semantic_preservation: An active campaign_id makes detector-evasion training fail closed. This consumed flag is retained as adaptive_evasion_fail_closed=true before removing campaign metadata. Historical DP-FilterFL controls use runtime_overrides.allow_unbalanced_dp_schedule=true to preserve uniform sampling while invalidating the epsilon label.
normalization.runtime_fields: Fresh names, output paths, noise seed paths, and per-run noise domain context are assigned when materialized. All remaining source parameter values are preserved.

runs.note: Current nearest-integer clipping and share-cache profile. Published floating-point utility and precomputed-input timing do not measure this profile.
